answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28558 Country: India Title: As per my company's policy,I can claim Rs 200/- without any bill while going back home at night. But, I come to office by auto in the afternoon for Rs 30/- and I go back home by Cab fo Rs 10/-. I claim Rs 40/-(30 10) per day for transport fare. Please let me know whether is it permissible or not. Question: As per my company's policy,I can claim Rs 200/- without any bill while going back home at night. But, I come to office by auto in the afternoon for Rs 30/- and I go back home by Cab fo Rs 10/-. I claim Rs 40/-(30 10) per day for transport fare. Please let me know whether is it permissible or not. Answer ID: 28558 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 71/60/L=1432) In the question mentioned above, it is lawful for you to take only as much amount as you spent in fare. It is not lawful to take extra amount by telling a lie. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
